notes: Flussonic media server: /<stream>/index.m3u8 is HLS, /<stream>/preview.jpg a still, /<stream>/preview.mp4 a short clip. All send access-control-allow-origin: * with no token.
No official coordinate API exists — /api/cctv, /api/camera and /publik/data are 404 and api.jakarta.go.id does not resolve. Positions come from a community mirror of the DKI open data release.
The mirror is stale: its own host cctv.balitower.co.id:80 is gone, and only about a third of its streams still answer on the current host. Hence the probe.
Dead streams stay in the snapshot with their status. A camera that comes back should not need the coordinate table re-derived.

The portal cameras on dki-jkt.balitower.co.id:7028 are the better ones — Thamrin, Gatot Subroto, S. Parman, Gerbang Pemuda, all on Transjakarta corridors, and 57% live against 29% of the geolocated set. Nothing geolocates them, so their position is recovered from the street name in the stream id via data/camera-places.json and OSM geometry. Those positions are ESTIMATES and are marked as such downstream.
streets.json is one Overpass query for every OSM feature that file names — ways with full geometry (sites on one street are spread along it), buildings and parks as a centre point.
No video is stored. The snapshot records that a camera exists and answered, nothing more.
